caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing male figure with short curly hair, playing a pan flute held to his lips with both hands. The figure is mostly unclothed, except for a green drapery wrapped around his waist and hanging over his left hip. His right arm is bent upward, supporting the flute, while his left arm is also raised, stabilizing the instrument. The figure is leaning slightly to his left against a vertical, branch-like support attached behind him, resembling a tree trunk or wooden post. The statue's surface shows grainy wood texture with light brown, tan, and pale gray colors, with the green garment providing a visible contrast. The background is plain and off-white, without any additional objects or scenery.
title: Circus Wagon Figure: Pan
